name: post_st_dropcolumn_selection_h24_v1
authorization: User requested an additional 24-month experiment after the 12-month selection support explanation, 2026-11-01
training_and_estimator: Same frozen conservative C83, next-open origin, announcement clocks, 24-month fit cap, q2 depth4 shared_quantile balanced25, seeds42/101/202 each32trees, direct raw-parent AJ10; no model change
selection_data: Only historical rolling held-out cohorts completely mature before the corresponding outer Jan1. Never outer-year outcomes or outer rankings.
support_gate: For primary24 only: at least2 mature informative cohorts, each with training target>=1, validation target>=3 and controls>=5; at least10 total target events in those cohorts. Operational minimum, not proof of adequate power.
primary_aggregation: Equal mean of within-cohort AP24; Top20 capture summed over cohort-specific ceil(0.2*N) quotas. Pooled metrics separately recalculated.
secondary_guard: 12-month guards use available mature cohorts with training target>=1 and validation target>=3; they do not require the separate12-month event gate. Weak support remains explicit. Undefined required guards stop approval, never become zero.
uncertainty: 500 common paired company resamples stratified by historical validation year, fixed IPCW; equal-year AP differences, seed2026110124. Intervals conditional on models, exploratory and no multiplicity guarantee.
initial_scan: Reuse all83 real single-deletion fits and frozen0.95 group B/C/D/representative candidates from parent, preserving hashes. Count25 mode only for selection. Linked audit columns76..82 are an atomic automatic-deletion block; individual audit deletions remain descriptive only.
recursive: Rank allowed initial removals by historical AP24 gain, take at most12 distinct removal units. At each step score every feasible remaining unit against the newly selected set; admit only candidates passing all constraints. Maximum12 deletion steps. Never reuse first-round scores after a deletion. Stop if no candidate passes.
local_repair: After an accepted deletion path, test at most12 one-variable restores or stable-group representative swaps among removed variables in the same initial pool, deterministic order by original feature id. Apply at mostone repair only if all the same guards pass. If no deletion is accepted, no repair is run.
stability: 50 company-level refits per cutoff, entry-year-stratified draws from the historical training companies, original company groups retained. Recompute the same support gate with unique companies and run the same full initial scan and guarded selector when supported. Unsupported replicates return83. Report unconditional inclusion separately from conditional selection given support, not as proof of indispensability. Do not expand to100 in this explicitly finite follow-up.
reuse_bootstrap_draws: Reuse parent repeat0..49 company draw indices, paired across all candidate feature sets and seeds; do not reuse the parent's closed12-month decision.
verification: Every new selected predictor and every candidate forest q<=2, valid CIF, save/reload and complete exact expansion at all training/evaluation rows and native times <=1e-10; no clipping. All model artifacts remain private. Compressed lossless model storage allowed.
budget: Finite 83 scan plus already-defined groups, max12 recursive rounds and max12 repair candidates, 50 resamples. Single-thread independent Slurm items on both nodes; measure pilot runtime and storage before large batch. Retain failures and all unfavourable outcomes.
outer_evaluation: Score only after cutoff-specific selections frozen. 2023-2025 already exposed, descriptive only. 2025 unsupported24-month metrics remainNA; evaluate12-month secondary result when supported. No automatic reference replacement.
scope_limit: This changes the selection objective, not the forest follow-up or fitting horizon. No new covariates, new clinical/research target or tuning on exposed cohorts. Selection stability needs replicated fitting; fixed-prediction resampling alone is not a substitute.
